video_title: Who Will Win The Most Games In The NBA This Season?

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon picks the Oklahoma City Thunder to win the most games
quotes.excerpt: I will take the Oklahoma City Thunder and hope that Jalen Williams in particular can have a healthy season.
quotes.quote: With the first overall pick, there is really two teams to choose from. I am going to go with the team that has had the most wins in the league the last couple of years. I am really going out on a limb here and I will take the Oklahoma City Thunder and hope that Jalen Williams in particular can have a healthy season.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst picks the San Antonio Spurs for his first win total draft selection
quotes.excerpt: I do think that the Spurs could go through an adjustment period. It does appear that Mitch Johnson is committed to starting the three guards, putting Dylan Harper into the starting lineup.
quotes.quote: With the second pick, I will go with the Spurs. I do think that the Spurs could go through an adjustment period. It does appear that Mitch Johnson is committed to starting the three guards, putting Dylan Harper into the starting lineup. And that to me is a no-brainer. They have to play that way, guys, because they are their three or their four best players.

quotes.speaker: Jackson Hoy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jackson Hoy picks the New York Knicks for his first win total draft selection
quotes.excerpt: I will go with the Knicks in part because this is public facing and I am a Knicks fan.
quotes.quote: If you were to give me truth serum, I would probably say that I think the Celtics finish with more win totals than the Knicks. But as a Knicks fan, I will go with the Knicks in part because this is public facing and I am a Knicks fan and I do not need that in my social media life. Thank you Jimmy Dolan. They have got a little bit of a cloud lingering over them as the season opens.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects the Detroit Pistons for his second win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I am taking the Detroit Pistons in this spot. I think they will be highly motivated after the way last season ended.
quotes.quote: I am taking the Detroit Pistons in this spot. I think they will be highly motivated after the way last season ended. Jalen Duren looked great in his first preseason game. Looks to be in good shape. I think Cade Cunningham, let us not forget, finished top five in MVP last year if I am not mistaken. I am not sure that the swap out of Tobias Harris and Isaiah Stewart losing those two guys and bringing in John Collins and Isaiah Joe, I am not sure that that swap out is ideal, but I do think that when Cade Cunningham is running pick and roll with Duren and or Collins, that that is a formidable thing to stop.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects the Cleveland Cavaliers for his second win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: Cleveland Cavaliers win a lot of regular season games. So, I do not know what to think of them in terms of the playoffs.
quotes.quote: Cleveland Cavaliers win a lot of regular season games. So, I do not know what to think of them in terms of the playoffs. I mean they did break through and get to the conference finals last year and analytically they did okay for a couple games, but did not end up winning any of them. That was a tough quote for Katy Adkins and I feel tough.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects the Denver Nuggets for his third win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: If Joker is healthy, you are just going to win a lot of regular season games.
quotes.quote: I am going to end up going with the Denver Nuggets, despite the fact that I did not, I thought their offseason was pretty rough as well, but if Joker is healthy, you are just going to win a lot of regular season games. I mean he is still arguably the best player in the league, certainly no lower than number three. He is one of the most dominant statistical players in the history of the game.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects the Houston Rockets for his third win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I am picking the Houston Rockets with Fred VanVleet. I thought the Rockets looked pretty good.
quotes.quote: I am picking the Houston Rockets with Fred VanVleet. I thought the Rockets looked pretty good. I thought Sengun looked pretty good. The thing about the Houston last year is we were, and I am not, and I do not regret this, but we were just obsessed with their late game failings because there was a lot of them. Fred VanVleet solves a lot of problems for them. He is the conductor down the stretch. He is the kind of voice of that team. Also, getting Stephen Adams back solves some problems for them. And then look, Katie is still an all NBA elite scorer. Amen Thompson is an ascending talent. Jabari Smith I think is is getting better. And then it looks like Sengun had a very good offseason.

quotes.speaker: Jackson Hoy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jackson Hoy selects the Minnesota Timberwolves and Los Angeles Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I will now take the Minnesota Timberwolves with my first selection and then the Los Angeles Lakers.
quotes.quote: I will now take the Minnesota Timberwolves with my first selection and then the Los Angeles Lakers with my second selection. I think both of these teams have pretty significant variance here. Two teams that are going to be really interesting to watch. The Timberwolves are going to be a league pass favorite for sure because they will be entertaining. For better or worse, they are going to be entertaining. And then the Lakers, man, I told you, I think it is interesting, the NBA GM survey came out and Luka did not get a single MVP vote. I think there is a path for him to win his first MVP and that is if the Lakers win 50 plus.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects the Toronto Raptors for his fourth win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I am going to take the Toronto Raptors, 46 wins last year and they added Kawhi Leonard.
quotes.quote: I am going to take the Toronto Raptors, 46 wins last year and they added Kawhi Leonard. I have no idea how many games he is going to play, but he was damn good last year. You know, if they can get 65, I know that that is a crazy if. I think the Raptors are elevated up there. Scotty Barnes playing alongside Kawhi, I think is a potentially devastating duo.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects the Philadelphia 76ers for his fourth win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I will take Philly. You know, I think speaking of fascinating teams, do you think ESPN is going to pay any attention to them though?
quotes.quote: I will take Philly. You know, I think speaking of fascinating teams, do you think ESPN is going to pay any attention to them though? We do want to welcome Chris Rim, who is our new Philadelphia based writer coming over from the NFL group. I tell you what, the Sixers are a lot of better season than the Chargers, the beat that he is leaving. The bigger over under with the Sixers to me is, well, there will be more than 20 games played with their core five together in the regular season. And that is the thing, especially with Embiid.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects the Miami Heat for his fifth win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I will take them. You know, same thing. I think they have got a lot of stuff to figure out.
quotes.quote: I will take them. You know, same thing. I think they have got a lot of stuff to figure out. I think the Bam Yannis thing is not going to be just seamless and smooth. But as we talked about earlier, defensively I think they are going to be really good. Obviously they have got a hell of a coach in Eric Spoelstra and you know, Yannis has I think something to prove.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects the Indiana Pacers for his fifth win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I am taking the Pacers and you know, like Haliburton and Zubac coming back, this is a team doing the flip.
quotes.quote: I am taking the Pacers and you know, like Haliburton and Zubac coming back, this is a team doing the flip. Pascal Siakam had a hell of a year last year. They have a very good coaching staff. So, I this is why I have a problem. I really, I do not feel great about any team. If you said you have to dead lock, otherwise you go to prison, that these teams in the East are going to be in the top six. I really am only picking the Knicks and I am picking that because of their continuity and Brunson.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects the Portland Trail Blazers for his sixth win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I am going to take the Portland Trail Blazers. 46 wins last year and they added Kawhi Leonard.
quotes.quote: I am going to take the Portland Trail Blazers. They are getting Dame Lillard back. You know, Dame is going to make shots. You know, obviously their roster is out of balance. They have got all these guards, but Denny Avia is a absolute force. That the guy is just going to put up points. He is going to score. He is going to put up points. And they get to play 41 home games. It is always been a tough place to play when they have got a halfway decent team and this is that way. And they were a playoff team last year.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects the Phoenix Suns for his sixth win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: The Suns might have overachieved last year. Certainly it is a lot more fun to be the scrappy overachiever.
quotes.quote: The Suns might have overachieved last year. Certainly it is a lot more fun to be the scrappy overachiever than the star studded disappointment. But they have got a hell of a coach in Jordan Knot. They have got a legit number one option in Devin Booker. They upgraded talent, I would I question the price they paid, but they made a talent upgrade getting Miles Bridges. 145 games last year and so I am going to go with the Suns here.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects the Golden State Warriors for his seventh win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I will hope Steph stays healthy and I will go with the Warriors.
quotes.quote: I will hope Steph stays healthy and I will go with the Warriors. We will see, you know, when Jimmy is back, what he looks like. If he is back in a Warriors uniform, I am not ruling out the possibility of them using his expiring contract in a trade. If they do, then that will be a big splash type of trade. But yeah, I will hope that Steph makes 400 so threes and wins some games.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects the Memphis Grizzlies for his seventh win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I am going to take the Memphis Grizzlies. Camboozer I think is going to put up enormous numbers.
quotes.quote: I am going to take the Memphis Grizzlies. Camboozer I think is going to put up enormous numbers. The GMs picked Camboozer, it was not, you know, overwhelming, but they picked Camboozer to be the favorite to win Rookie of the Year and I I understand that. He is going to put up big numbers. I just want to point out, like Ty Jerome, he missed like all of last year. That guy is a player who can make a difference in he is going to help them win some games. Zack Edie is currently healthy. I have no idea if he is going to stay healthy. That is a guy who, knock on wood, yeah, causes problems for teams. Cedric Howard is a good young player. I mean they have got some good they have got some good young players on the roster. You know, they you know, look, okay. Jeremy Grant is a sixth man, like okay. At 35 million dollars, that is not what you want to be paying your sixth man, but all right, like he is a I am not going to I am not going to defend this. The people who I respect are telling me the Grizzlies are better than than than they think. So, I am going to use that information at this point in the season.

quotes.speaker: Jackson Hoy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jackson Hoy selects the Utah Jazz for his seventh win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I am going to go with the Jazz with my first pick there.
quotes.quote: I am going to go with the Jazz with my first pick there. I do, I am buying what they are selling on the flip not necessarily on the defensive end, but at this point in the draft, if a team can score some points, they are going to win they are going to win some games and they sure want to win games and you know, I am a fan of our pod friend and the coach with Will Hardy there. So, going to go with the Jazz with my first pick there.

quotes.speaker: Jackson Hoy
quotes.summary_phrase: Jackson Hoy selects the Washington Wizards for his eighth win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I will now take the Wizards. I am going to go with another team.
quotes.quote: I will now take the Wizards. I am going to go with another team. I am buying on the flip and I am don't know if I am really buying the Wizards, but at this point in time with the teams we are selecting, like I I believe that they will be trying hard and that there is enough talent to win a reasonable number of games.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst selects the Dallas Mavericks for his eighth win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I am taking the Mavericks. Anytime I get a chance to invest in Cooper Flagg, I will take him.
quotes.quote: I am taking the Mavericks. Anytime I get a chance to invest in Cooper Flagg, I will take him. I know, it is I can hear, this is the thing, I have been damaged by Bontemps because like whenever I start talking about like praising Cooper Flagg, which I have done a lot in the last week, another discovery. Another discovery. Uh, yeah, I know, I know he has been a star since he was 16, he went to Duke, number one overall pick, rookie of the year, I get that, but um, yeah, I will go with Dallas. And the Kyrie thing will be talking about. There was a wide differential between the Mavericks and the Rockets as we watched them last week. I know that is not a hot take, but

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon selects the Charlotte Hornets for his eighth win total draft pick
quotes.excerpt: I will take Charlotte here. Don't love the injury situation leading into the season.
quotes.quote: I will take Charlotte here. Don't love the injury situation leading into the season, but the numbers with Kobe White and not Lamelo on the floor last year were very good. Lamelo definitely drove their offense, but Kobe White went there for most of the season and so I do not think I do not think the bottom falls out on the Hornets. I still think they are hovering around 500.
